h1: Custom White Putty for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom white putty in bulk. Perfect for trade shows and giveaways. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: White custom putty offers a clean, neutral canvas for your logo or message, making it a versatile choice for corporate giveaways or event handouts. Unlike colored putty, white works well with full-color imprinting, ensuring your brand stands out clearly. Ideal for trade shows, office stress relief, or promotional kits, these soft, non-toxic putties can be screen printed or pad printed with your design. Ordering in bulk keeps costs low while maximizing your brand exposure.
heroAltText: Assorted custom white putty with company logos printed on the surface for promotional use
